comment: Endless Arena waves (docs/ARENA.md Part 5). Enemy budget = baseCount + perWave x (wave - 1), up to maxCount (minions count half). Enemies come from the weeks unlocked by waveForWeek; every 5th wave is an elite wave, every 10th a remixed boss. Between waves the party gets breatherMp MP back, no HP.

cardReward.comment: PT Part 6: after every wave, pick 1 of 'choices' cards or skip for skipScraps. Rarity weights move from 'early' to 'late' by wave lateWave; cards in the party's Vectors are weighted by partyVectorWeight; newVectorChance is the chance one offer is a Vector nobody in the party knows.

checkpointPick.comment: PT Part 6: every checkpoint, one party member picks 1 of 'choices' perks (Techniques once PT Part 8 lands).

themes.comment: User request (Oct 28): every block of 'blockSize' waves shares one theme (its hazard set and an enemy Vector lean), so each checkpoint is a chance to rebuild decks for the next theme. Themes are picked per block (seeded, no repeat back to back). 'lean' is how strongly enemies match the theme's Vectors (higher = purer).

list.name: Fire Drill
list.text: Burning floors and things that like it hot. Bring Cold and Motion.

list.name: Cold Snap
list.text: Ice underfoot, frost in the air. Heat melts it; Force shatters it.

list.name: Pitfall
list.text: Holes everywhere and heavy hitters. Push them in first.

list.name: Trench War
list.text: Cover everywhere and shooters behind it. Flank or blow it up.

list.name: Rune Maze
list.text: Hidden traps and things that hold you still. Light reveals.

list.name: Cave-In
list.text: The floor won't hold for long. Neither will they.

list.name: Assembly Line
list.text: Everything moves, fast. Root things down.

list.name: Lights Out
list.text: You can't see them. They can see you. Bring Light.

list.name: Toxic Spill
list.text: Puddles that eat armor. Heal often; Transmutation cleans.

bossNote: User request (Oct 28): a boss every 5th wave, each with a gimmick from data/arena/gimmicks.json; elites every 4th wave (a boss wave wins when both land).
loopNote: After loopAt waves the arena starts over (weeks, themes, bosses, gimmicks) with everything loopMul times stronger per loop (user request, Oct 28).
